en: A large amount or number of something; or a piece of land; or a way to decide by chance.
ex: We have a lot of homework to do tonight.
我們今晚有很多功課要做。

en: Making a lot of noise; or easy to hear.
ex: The music was too loud, so I turned it down.
音樂太大聲了，所以我把它調小。

en: A strong feeling of caring for someone; or to like something very much.
ex: I love my family very much.
我非常愛我的家人。

en: Very beautiful or pleasant.
ex: What a lovely garden you have!
你的花園真漂亮！

en: Not high; near the ground; or small in amount; or feeling sad.
ex: The ceiling in this room is very low.
這個房間的天花板很低。

en: Having good things happen to you by chance.
ex: I was lucky to find a seat on the crowded train.
我很幸運在擁擠的火車上找到座位。

en: The meal you eat in the middle of the day.
ex: We have lunch at noon in the school canteen.
我們中午在學校餐廳吃午餐。

en: A piece of equipment with moving parts that does a particular job.
ex: This machine can make coffee in one minute.
這台機器一分鐘就能煮好咖啡。

en: Very angry; or mentally ill; or very silly or foolish.
ex: She was mad at him for being late.
她對他遲到很生氣。

en: The power to make impossible things happen by saying special words; or tricks done to entertain people.
ex: The magician did a magic trick with a hat.
魔術師用一頂帽子變了個魔術。

en: Letters and parcels that are sent by post; or to send something by post.
ex: I will mail the letter this afternoon.
我今天下午會寄這封信。

en: Most important or largest of its kind; or a large pipe that carries water or gas.
ex: The main street of the town is always busy.
這個鎮上的大街總是很熱鬧。

en: To produce or create something; or to cause something to happen; or to force someone to do something.
ex: She makes a cake for her brother every birthday.
她每年生日都為弟弟做一個蛋糕。

en: An adult male person; or people in general; or to operate a machine.
ex: The man is reading a newspaper on the bench.
那個男人正坐在長椅上看報紙。

en: A large number of; used with countable nouns.
ex: There are many books on the shelf.
書架上有許多書。

en: A drawing of an area showing features such as roads, rivers and cities.
ex: We looked at the map to find the road.
我們看地圖找那條路。

en: A spot or line on something; or the score given for schoolwork; or to give a grade; or a sign.
ex: She got full marks in the English test.
她英語考試得了滿分。

en: A place where people buy and sell goods; or the demand for goods; or to sell something.
ex: We buy fresh vegetables at the market every Sunday.
我們每個星期天都去市場買新鮮蔬菜。

en: Having a husband or wife; or relating to marriage.
ex: They have been married for ten years.
他們結婚十年了。

en: The science of numbers, shapes and quantities.
ex: She is very good at math.
她很擅長數學。

en: A subject or situation that you must deal with; or physical material; or to be important.
ex: What is the matter with you? You look sad.
你怎麼了？你看起來很難過。

en: Used to ask permission or say that something is possible; also the fifth month of the year.
ex: May I use your pen for a moment?
我可以借用你的筆一下嗎？

en: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
明天也許會下雨，所以帶把傘。

en: The food you eat at one time, such as breakfast, lunch or dinner.
ex: We had a delicious meal at the new restaurant.
我們在新餐廳吃了一頓美味的飯。

en: To express a meaning; or to intend to do something; or unkind or unfair to someone.
ex: What does this word mean?
這個字是什麼意思？

en: The flesh of animals that is eaten as food.
ex: He doesn't eat meat; he is a vegetarian.
他不吃肉，他是素食者。

en: The main ways that large numbers of people receive information, such as TV, radio and newspapers.
ex: The media reported the news all day.
媒體整天都在報導這則新聞。

en: A substance you take to treat an illness; or the science of treating illness.
ex: The doctor told me to take the medicine three times a day.
醫生叫我一天吃三次藥。

en: Of middle size, amount or level; or a way of communicating information.
ex: I would like a medium pizza, please.
請給我一個中號披薩。

en: To come together with someone by chance or by plan; or to see someone for the first time; or to satisfy a need.
ex: I will meet you at the station at six.
我六點在車站和你碰面。

en: An event where people come together to discuss something; or the act of meeting someone.
ex: The manager is in a meeting right now.
經理現在正在開會。

en: A person who belongs to a group or club.
ex: She is a member of the school choir.
她是學校合唱團的成員。

en: A list of food and drinks in a restaurant; or a list of choices on a computer screen.
ex: The waiter handed us the menu.
服務生把菜單遞給我們。

en: The part of something that is farthest from the edges; or in the center.
ex: The table is in the middle of the room.
桌子在房間的中央。

en: A white liquid that comes from cows and that people drink; or to take milk from an animal.
ex: I drink a glass of milk every morning.
我每天早上喝一杯牛奶。

en: The number 1,000,000; or a very large number.
ex: More than a million people live in this city.
超過一百萬人住在這座城市。

en: The part of you that thinks and feels; or to be annoyed by something; or to take care of something.
ex: Do you mind if I open the window?
你介意我開窗嗎？

en: A deep hole in the ground from which coal, gold or metal is taken out; or a bomb placed in the ground; or belonging to me.
ex: My father worked in a coal mine for twenty years.
我父親在煤礦工作了二十年。

en: A period of time equal to sixty seconds; or a very short time; or extremely small.
ex: Please wait a minute while I check the schedule.
請稍等一下，我確認一下時間表。

en: To fail to hit or catch something; or to feel sad because someone is not with you; or a title for a young woman.
ex: I missed the last train and had to take a taxi.
我錯過末班車，只好搭計程車。
